title: Sound and music in U sixty-four BBC BASIC.
bbc: SOUND and ENVELOPE work as on a BBC Micro. In BBC mode they even sound like one: here a siren envelope, a falling tone, and noise.
sid: In SID mode, SOUND reaches all twenty-four voices of eight SIDs, with instruments: here instrument one, and a chord on three voices.
sid24: This demo writes the eight SIDs directly: twenty-four voices, entering one by one.
build: The music demo builds each piece from BASIC, note by note, with SOUND commands, while the song tracker records them.
play: Then the song tracker plays it in the background, on twenty-four voices, while BASIC draws the bars.
audio: On the Ultimate sixty-four, Ultimate Audio plays ProTracker MOD music from the R E U, through a port of Freshness's ModPlayer.
fx: Sample sound effects play on the free channels, over the music.
sam: And with your own copy of S.A.M., it speaks.
credits: U sixty-four BBC BASIC is free and open source. Find it on GitHub. The next video is about files, the Ultimate, and the network.
